scenes.title: Opening Theme Song
scenes.summary: Opening title sequence for Episode 8 of Behind the Scenes.

scenes.title: Handing Over Entertainment Talk
scenes.summary: At a joint meeting with DTS, Kaiwen and Xingzi announce Chun Yuqiao's decision to hand Entertainment Talk over completely to Unit Two while requesting a few days on Twelve Singers until he recovers.

scenes.title: Blue-Ocean Strategy and Overhaul
scenes.summary: Back in the chief editor's office, Kaiwen and Xingzi explain to Bu Xiaogu why Chun Yuqiao despises copycat competition with ME and wants a sweeping overhaul of Twelve Singers.

scenes.title: Two Plans and Xiaogu's Draft
scenes.summary: Kaiwen proposes preparing both a safe backup plan and a true revamp, and Bu Xiaogu amazes the team by revealing the localization draft she prepared after studying every season of Twelve Singers.

scenes.title: Moving the Pitch Meeting Forward
scenes.summary: Assistant Qin Xiao persuades the network director to move the Twelve Singers pitch review forward by two days while Chun Yuqiao is still recovering in hospital.

scenes.title: No Time to Show the Boss
scenes.summary: Qin Xiao delivers notice that the pitch meeting has been moved forward; Bu Xiaogu spots the rivalry between Xingzi and Qin Xiao, and the trio vows not to disturb Chun Yuqiao at the hospital.

scenes.title: Tabloid Photos Outside the Hospital
scenes.summary: Spotting paparazzi photos of a disguised Xin Huimei visiting Chun Yuqiao's hospital, Bu Xiaogu abruptly reverses her promise and hurries off to check on the boss.

scenes.title: Looking Much Better in Hospital
scenes.summary: In the hospital ward, Chun Yuqiao wakes from dreaming about work to find Bu Xiaogu visiting, thanks her for helping the night he collapsed, and reminds her to look after herself far from home.

scenes.title: Stomach-Soothing Porridge and Canteen Vouchers
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu asks about Chun Yuqiao's three-year stomach ailment and offers to make her mother's soothing porridge, while he reveals he gave her extra canteen vouchers to spare her from her own cooking.

scenes.title: IV Needle Marks and Quiet Company
scenes.summary: Seeing the row of IV needle marks on Chun Yuqiao's hand, Bu Xiaogu recalls a lonely childhood hospital stay, promises the team will work hard so he falls ill less often, and stays a little longer.

scenes.title: Rolling Cameras on the Revamped Talk Show
scenes.summary: In Studio Four, Lin Jie checks catering for a Thai comedy star and greets host Wen Simo along with his unannounced guest before calling everyone to places for the revamped show.

scenes.title: Honey Allergy Emergency on Set
scenes.summary: Wen Simo opens the revamped Entertainment Talk and welcomes the Thai guest, only for the guest's interpreter to suffer a sudden honey allergy from the crew meal—triggering Kaiwen's emergency plan.

scenes.title: Saving the Taping in Thai
scenes.summary: With the interpreter rushed to hospital and Wen Simo's schedule tight, the visiting fan-club president steps in to interpret in fluent Thai so Wen Simo can wrap the interview smoothly.

scenes.title: Chun Yuqiao's Surprise Return as Chief Content Officer
scenes.summary: Freshly discharged and promoted to Chief Content Officer, Chun Yuqiao arrives in Studio Four to a congratulatory cake—then sternly holds Unit Two accountable for missing the allergy check.

scenes.title: Wen Simo and Chun Yuqiao Backstage
scenes.summary: Meeting backstage for the first time, veteran host Wen Simo advises Chun Yuqiao not to reprimand subordinates in front of foreign guests, and Chun Yuqiao bluntly shares why he left his former network.

scenes.title: Fifteen Minutes Before the Pitch
scenes.summary: As Xingzi, Bu Xiaogu, and Kaiwen puzzle over Chun Yuqiao's early hospital discharge, Qin Xiao gives a 15-minute warning and Kaiwen prepares to pitch the conservative plan—until Chun Yuqiao walks in.

scenes.title: Outside Guests at an Internal Pitch
scenes.summary: Arriving at Xingtian, Chun Yuqiao spots Qin Xiao bringing sponsors and talent agents to turn an internal pitch into a pressure test—then calmly takes his seat in the boardroom.

scenes.title: Bu Xiaogu Pitches Double Elimination
scenes.summary: Finding the full overhaul slide deck on the screen, Chun Yuqiao invites its planner to present, and Bu Xiaogu steps up before Xingtian's leadership to introduce her double-elimination format.

scenes.title: Backing Complete Format Reform
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao throws his full weight behind Bu Xiaogu's overhaul, arguing that true reform must start with the core rules despite objections from nervous talent agents and sponsors.

scenes.title: Reform and Live, Stagnate and Die
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao challenges the room over blind reliance on overseas formats—declaring 'reform and live, fail to reform and die'—and tells his energized team they will push the revamp all the way.

scenes.title: Synced Files and Quiet Approval
scenes.summary: Delivering the meeting minutes, Bu Xiaogu speaks up for Lin Jie's sincerity and learns that Chun Yuqiao read her draft via his synced old computer and placed it on the pitch desktop himself.

scenes.title: Xin Huimei Confesses Her Feelings
scenes.summary: Over dinner in a private room, Wen Simo asks why Xin Huimei dressed so discreetly to visit the hospital, and she honestly tells him that her heart now belongs to Chun Yuqiao.

scenes.title: Wen Simo Seeks Out Chun Yuqiao's Past
scenes.summary: Shaken by Xin Huimei's confession, Wen Simo agrees to attend a commercial event he usually avoids so he can meet Luo Lin onstage and ask her privately about Chun Yuqiao.
scenes.location: dressing room and commercial event stage
